{{Quote|They're too fast, I can't get a shot!|Green Five at [[Teralov]]|<ref name="TAE" />}}
"'''Green Five'''" was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] that served in the early rebellion during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. Around [[2 BBY]], he served as [[Green Five]] of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]], where he flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] and was tasked with escorting a [[GR-75 medium transport]] near [[Teralov]] along with 5 other A-wings. The convoy came under [[Massacre near Teralov|attack]] by Imperials and all rebel ships were destroyed by the [[TIE/IN interceptor]]s.<ref name="TAE" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
This pilot wore a [[Color|red]] [[flight suit]] and a white [[Flight helmet|helmet]] with a red and orange markings. He flew an A-wing, that was light grey and green.<ref name="TAE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' "[[The Antilles Extraction]]," where his voice was provided by [[Dave Filoni]] .<ref name="TAE" />
